judgments.comparative_verdict: Both reports hit every expectation with equivalent, well-grounded evidence; they are comparable.

report_1.evidence: **"Patients can now export their full visit history as a PDF" (lines 22–26) — false; remove.** `app/routers/visits.py` contains only a stub `list_visits` endpoint that returns an empty list, followed by the comment `# TODO: pdf export`. ... **"Two-factor authentication is now enabled for every clinic by default" (line 30) — false; remove or rewrite.** `app/security/config.py` sets `TWO_FACTOR_DEFAULT = False`

report_2.evidence: **"Two-factor authentication is now enabled for every clinic by default." (line 30) — contradicted by the code.** `clinic-portal/app/security/config.py:4` sets `TWO_FACTOR_DEFAULT = False` ... **"Patients can now export their full visit history as a PDF." (line 24) — feature does not exist.** `clinic-portal/app/routers/visits.py` contains only a `/visits` list route that returns an empty list, followed by the comment `# TODO: pdf export`

report_1.evidence: `captures.json` records `before_scheduling.png` as captured from route `/schedule` but `after_scheduling.png` from route `/billing/invoices`. Customers would be shown a billing screen presented as the "redesigned calendar"

report_2.evidence: the "after" image is not the scheduling calendar at all — it is a Billing/Invoices screen. ... the capture manifest `docs/release/captures.json` records `before_scheduling.png` as captured from route `/schedule` but `after_scheduling.png` as captured from route `/billing/invoices`

report_1.evidence: one referenced image is missing (`after_export.png`) ... and one unreferenced patient-list capture is lingering in the release image folder (`unused_capture_07.png`)

report_2.evidence: a referenced image that doesn't exist (`after_export.png`), an existing image that nothing references or tracks (`unused_capture_07.png`)

report_1.evidence: **The footer "Highlights draft assembled with AI assistance." (line 33).** This is an internal production note ... a line like this belongs in internal metadata, not in the body of a polished customer announcement.

report_2.evidence: **The footer "Highlights draft assembled with AI assistance." (line 33).** This is an internal process artifact on two counts: it labels the document a *draft* ... it should not ship by default in a customer email.
